headline: Recommended final passage of ordinance O-26-022 establishing the Video Display Signs Overlay District.
summary: The committee held a public hearing on O-26-022, establishing the Video Display Signs Overlay District, with testimony for and against. The committee also received a referral communication on the ordinance and heard presentations on electronic signs and inclusionary zoning. The committee voted to recommend final passage of O-26-022.
decisions: Recommended final passage of ordinance O-26-022, establishing the Video Display Signs Overlay District, with Alderman Sullivan opposed.
